title: General equation for settling velocity of a discrete particle in the transition zone
readable: Vs = SQRT[(4/3)(g / CD)((rho_s - rho) / rho)] d

symbols.definition: Mass density of grit particle, kg/m3
Newton coefficient of Drag which is a function of Reynolds number

applicability: Settling velocity of a discrete particle where transition flow conditions hold, that is Reynolds number between 1 and 1,000.
notes: The printed radical encloses 4/3, g/CD and (rho_s - rho)/rho; the factor d is printed outside the radical and is kept outside.
CD is defined in the surrounding prose, not in the printed symbol list.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page PNGs, plus enlarged crops at 288-720 dpi and a contact sheet of every hashed source region; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First visual transcription only. Every printed glyph, power, subscript, inequality, unit, hyphen spacing, footnote and printed error was read from the rendered source and retained or flagged; no value inferred.
